roster.name: Ontology for Biomedical Investigations (OBI)
roster.description: An OBO Foundry ontology defining >2500 terms to describe biomedical investigations (assays, devices, objectives, specimens, study designs, data sets, outputs). Provides stable identifiers, human-readable labels, textual and logical definitions, and guidance for term submission and editing (templates, OWL/ROBOT workflows).

roster.name: IAO Ontology Metadata
roster.description: Annotation vocabulary / metadata standard used for ontology term metadata (editor-preferred term/label, alternative terms, textual definition, definition source, logical-definition annotations, examples of usage, term editor). OBI’s term guidelines explicitly require and describe these IAO metadata annotations for new terms.

roster.name: Web Ontology Language (OWL) — OWL 2
roster.description: The machine-readable ontology language used to encode logical definitions and axioms for OBI terms (most OBI terms are OWL classes with parent classes and OWL axioms). The site explains using OWL 2 for logical definitions and machine-readable semantics.
